_comment: Test fixtures for the AI tells scanner. Each entry has dirty text (should match the named pattern) and clean text (should NOT match anything). Run with: python3 test_patterns.py

should_match.text: The bed wasn't laziness. It was a working arrangement that suited him.
She wasn't a writer of small ambitions. She was after the biggest book she could imagine.
The point isn't furniture. It's hierarchy.
What's interesting isn't that the rooms were cheap. It's that they were almost empty.
He was not a clerk pushing paper. He was a trained lawyer.
She didn't write fast. She was a slow writer.
He didn't waste time. He had a system that worked.
The lesson isn't to move to Sussex. It's to be honest about the cost.
She knew the truth—and it terrified her.
The tension in the room was palpable.
It was a visceral reaction, not a thought.
The story resonated with him for years.
She had a profound effect on his work.
Her commitment was unwavering.
He was utterly exhausted by the end.
She navigated the complexities of publishing with care.
Moreover, the schedule was nonnegotiable.
Here's the thing about Hemingway. He stood while he wrote.
The reality is most writers procrastinate.
The truth is his routine is learnable.

should_not_match.text: The bed was a working arrangement that suited him, even though Twain played it as laziness.
The point is hierarchy more than furniture.
She knew the truth, and it terrified her.
He sat at the bookshelf and wrote five hundred words. Then he stopped, mid-sentence, and walked outside.

should_not_match.description: Negative statement without a pivot follow-up
should_not_match.text: She didn't write fast, and she didn't apologize for it.

should_not_match.description: The truth is followed by 'that' or 'in/out' (clause continuation, not pivot)
should_not_match.text: The truth is that most writers don't read enough.

should_not_match.description: Negative statement inside a single sentence (not followed by period+positive)
should_not_match.text: He wasn't trying to be productive in the modern sense, just trying to make his daily target so achievable that there was no reason to skip it.

should_not_match.description: Sequential narrative actions are NOT a pivot
should_not_match.text: She didn't start writing immediately. She made coffee.

should_not_match.description: Sequential factual statement is NOT a pivot
should_not_match.text: She didn't write at home. She rented a hotel room.
